profile.name: Rimil Dey
profile.summary: Senior frontend engineer with 7 years of experience shipping thoughtful, responsive product experiences across high-growth teams. Known for redesigning complex surfaces, improving maintainability, and partnering closely with design and product.

homepageNarrative.eyebrow: Currently at Cercli · Available for senior frontend roles and selective consulting
homepageNarrative.headline: I design clarity into complex product surfaces.
homepageNarrative.dek: A frontend engineer with product taste: redesigning dashboards, strengthening systems, and shipping interfaces that feel calm, fast, and considered.
homepageNarrative.supportingLine: 7 years across Cercli, Deel, Paradime Labs, Appsmith, Rippling, and Springboard. React, TypeScript, Angular, design systems, performance, accessibility, and product collaboration.
